label: An actual concretum's distinct esse CAUSE_2 is its actual CONCRETE_AND_ABSTRACT_6 ground
paraphrase: At the selected world w, for any c and x, if x is actual and concrete, c is distinct from x, and c causes the supplied esse actuality of x, then c is concrete, exists at w and grounds x under the selected relation.
note: Records the pre-existing EsseCauseIsActualConcreteGround predicate as an OPEN, unattributed interface, not a newly proved premise. No converse, global-world claim, causal sufficiency or completeness of explanation is asserted. ExistsAt w is world-relative existence, not temporal concurrence or presentism: a complete-history interpretation may include past producers not alive now. Historical production alone does not establish the supplied esse-cause or grounds relation; their sustaining interpretation requires separate defense. An explicit world/time coherence interface would be needed to read existence at w as presence at a designated time; none is part of this predicate.
